custom_expected:
EXPECTED (per spec): a 'Cannot Delete' modal appears with 'This role is assigned to N user(s). Reassign them to another role before deleting.' and the confirm button is disabled.
BUILD-VS-SPEC DISCREPANCY (observed): there is NO 'Cannot Delete' modal in the build. Instead deletion is prevented two ways: (1) the list three-dot menu hides the 'Delete' item when users > 0 (shows only 'View Permissions'); (2) the editor 'Delete Role' button is disabled with tooltip 'This role is assigned to 1 user(s). Reassign them to another role before deleting.' Flag this as a build-vs-spec gap (spec expects a modal).
custom_preconds: A custom role assigned to at least 1 user
custom_steps:
1. Attempt to delete the role from the list three-dot menu
2. Open the role editor and inspect the Delete Role control
title: Custom role with 1+ users cannot be deleted (spec: Cannot Delete modal)
